show.description: In a world ruled by power and deception, an ordinary young woman is forced into a deadly political game. False imprisonment, a shattered bond of motherhood, and a shocking engagement twist become steppingstones toward revenge. Supreme Beauty is a saga of drama, secrets, and hidden truths that redefine survival.
